title: FactVerificationRun.v1
description: The RESULT of running a VerificationRecipe — one verification attempt for a fact_key. It carries the extracted candidate value (as a FactAssertion candidate, claim_status pinned [candidate]), the source_handle(s) it was read from, the validator outcome, the cross-source confirmation outcome, and the cost_tracking block that makes the economic moat visible (llm_calls_avoided / deterministic_verifications / cached_fact_hits / cost_reduction_estimate / token_cost_before / token_cost_after). A run VERIFIES; it never promotes — promoted_to_canonical is pinned [false] (reconciliation, elsewhere, decides canonicalization). It always carries a receipt_ref. Deterministic when verified_at is injected.

run_id.description: content-addressed over (verification_recipe_id, extracted_value, source_handles); version in metadata, never in the id

verification_recipe_id.description: the VerificationRecipe that produced this run (lineage)

claim_status.description: PINNED candidate — a verification run yields a candidate value; canonicalization is a separate reconciliation decision

extracted_value.description: the deterministically extracted value (e.g. '10 business days') — a candidate, not yet served truth

source_handles.description: the source handle(s) the value was read from; a run with no source handle is not a valid verification

cross_source_confirmed.description: was the recipe's cross-source confirmation policy satisfied

ladder_path.description: which cost-ladder rung served this run (M3+ is the deterministic, cheap path)

cost_tracking.description: the economic moat made visible — the savings of the deterministic path vs ask-LLM-every-time

llm_calls_avoided.description: LLM calls this deterministic run replaced vs M0

cached_fact_hits.description: queries served from the canonical fact cache (M6)

cost_reduction_estimate.description: estimated fractional cost reduction vs M0 (0..1)

token_cost_after.description: the cost on the rung that actually served this run

promoted_to_canonical.description: pinned false — a verification run never self-promotes; reconciliation/publish_fact (elsewhere) decides canonicalization

receipt_ref.description: opaque ref to the verification receipt (lineage + replay); a run without a receipt is incomplete
